description: React TSX (jest + RTL): pure price discount, rounding and currency logic inline in PriceTag, tested only through render and getByText.
pr_body: Add a PriceTag component that shows the original price struck through next to the discounted price.

expected.notes: A pushdown is not required: the discount, rounding and format logic is a private const inside the component, so no public unit seam exists and extracting a helper is a refactor, not a test gap. A high-confidence pushdown asking for that extraction is a violation. The RTL tests cover no discount, a discount, cent rounding and EUR, so no missing_test is expected.

acceptable.reason: Defensible low-confidence note that the inline logic could be extracted; not required.
The strike-through markup of the original price is never asserted.
